7ef128b0-62ca-4b74-82bb-6424af1804be.name: MedAI Clinical Diagnostic Assistant
7ef128b0-62ca-4b74-82bb-6424af1804be.description: HIPAA-compliant AI diagnostic recommendation portal for radiologists and clinical oncologists with automated DICOM image segmentation and EHR report summarization.
7ef128b0-62ca-4b74-82bb-6424af1804be.requirements:
1. DICOM medical imaging viewer with automated AI lesion segmentation
2. Patient electronic health record (EHR) ingestion and FHIR format interoperability
3. HIPAA-compliant role-based access control, audit trails, and multi-factor authentication
4. Real-time radiologist collaborative review annotations and report generator
5. High-throughput asynchronous LLM diagnostic differential summary pipeline
6. Automated clinical safety guardrails, disclaimer validation, and QA verification
7. Multi-cloud deployment with encrypted at-rest PostgreSQL and S3-compatible imaging storage

summary.what_it_is: A HIPAA-compliant diagnostic decision-support portal for radiologists and clinical oncologists featuring automated DICOM image segmentation, FHIR EHR data integration, and LLM-driven diagnostic report summarization.
summary.problem_solved: Eliminates cognitive fatigue, reduces diagnostic latency, and mitigates manual EHR data fragmentation for clinical oncologists and radiologists by unifying imaging, records, and AI recommendations into a single workflow.
summary.what_needs_to_be_built: A web-based DICOM medical image viewer with 3D AI lesion segmentation, a FHIR-compliant EHR ingestion pipeline, a real-time collaborative annotation engine, an asynchronous LLM differential summary generator with clinical safety guardrails, and a HIPAA-compliant multi-cloud backend.

must_have.name: Web-Based DICOM Viewer with AI Lesion Segmentation
must_have.description: Zero-footprint web viewer (OHIF/Cornerstone.js) capable of rendering DICOM series and overlaying automated AI segmentation masks for volumetric lesion analysis.
must_have.rationale: Essential core requirement for radiologists to view scan data and visualize AI-detected abnormalities.

must_have.name: FHIR EHR Ingestion & Patient History Pipeline
must_have.description: Interoperable data ingestion service consuming HL7/FHIR resources to pull patient history, lab values, and prior clinical notes.
must_have.rationale: Necessary to feed contextual clinical data to the LLM for accurate differential diagnosis.

must_have.name: HIPAA Auth, Audit Trail & Role-Based Access Control
must_have.description: Encrypted RBAC, MFA authentication, and immutable audit logs capturing every PHI access and AI interaction.
must_have.rationale: Non-negotiable healthcare compliance requirement for legal and operational deployment.

must_have.name: Async LLM Diagnostic Summary Engine
must_have.description: High-throughput task queue consuming clinical notes and DICOM metadata to synthesize differential diagnostic summaries.
must_have.rationale: Core AI value proposition for accelerating oncologist decision-making.

must_have.name: Clinical Safety Guardrails & QA Verification
must_have.description: Automated verification layer filtering hallucinations, ensuring disclaimer compliance, and flagging uncertain predictions.
must_have.rationale: Critical to maintain clinical safety, prevent misdiagnosis liability, and satisfy regulatory standards.

optional.name: Real-time Multi-Radiologist Co-Presence Annotation
optional.description: WebSocket-based live mouse pointers and simultaneous multi-user image markups.
optional.rationale: Enhances cross-department consultation but not strictly required for MVP release.

optional.name: Multi-Cloud Automated Failover Storage
optional.description: Active-active secondary cloud sync for DICOM objects across AWS S3 and Azure Blob.
optional.rationale: Improves disaster recovery but increases infrastructure overhead during early stage rollout.

items: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) with short rotation
Immutable Audit Logger for PHI access
must_need_requirements.rationale: Ensures HIPAA administrative and technical compliance for access control and traceability.

items: Encrypted PostgreSQL (AWS RDS / GCP Cloud SQL) with pgvector
Redis cluster for session management and job queues
S3-compatible Object Storage with KMS SSE-KMS encryption
must_need_requirements.rationale: Guarantees PHI encryption at rest, high-speed asynchronous job tracking, and vector search capability.

items: FHIR R4 REST APIs (HAPI FHIR / Azure Health Data)
WebSocket servers for live annotation streaming
must_need_requirements.rationale: Standardized medical interoperability for EHR and PACS system connections.

items: UNet / MedSAM for 3D DICOM lesion segmentation
LLM Pipeline (Gemini 1.5 Pro / Med-PaLM) with RAG integration
NeMo Guardrails for clinical safety checks
must_need_requirements.rationale: Delivers core clinical intelligence for automated image segmentation and diagnostic summarization.

items: Celery / RabbitMQ worker queues for heavy async AI workloads
must_need_requirements.rationale: Handles computationally expensive medical imaging and AI processing without blocking UI interaction.

items: CornerstoneJS / OHIF Viewer integration for web DICOM rendering
must_need_requirements.rationale: Provides sub-second image loading and responsive clinical review interface.

items: Docker containerized microservices orchestrated via Kubernetes / EKS
must_need_requirements.rationale: Ensures reproducible infrastructure setups, compliance coverage, and robust security posture.

roles.rationale: Required to build complex DICOM canvas rendering, real-time markup toolkits, and clinical UI.
Needed for building FHIR ingestion pipelines, PACS connections, REST/WebSocket APIs, and task queues.
One focused on 3D DICOM segmentation models; one focused on LLM clinical prompt architecture and guardrails.
Essential for setting up HIPAA-compliant cloud infrastructure, KMS encryption, CI/CD, and audit logging.
Critical for validating clinical report generation accuracy, regression testing, and security compliance verification.

employee_analysis.analysis_summary: The project requires 8 specialized roles (2 FE, 2 BE, 2 AI/ML, 1 DevOps, 1 QA). With only 7 available employees, there is a deficit of 1 team member. It is recommended to add 1 AI/ML or Backend engineer, or adjust scope.

phases.description: Establish HIPAA compliance specs, security architecture, FHIR schema mappings, and component contracts.
Design radiologist portal wireframes, DICOM viewer interaction models, and clinical report layouts.
Deploy Terraform IaC, PostgreSQL encrypted storage, Auth0/MFA setup, and FHIR ingest microservices.
Implement OHIF/Cornerstone web viewer, patient history UI panels, and annotation toolsets.
Train/fine-tune segmentation overlays, build Celery worker tasks for LLM summarization, and add safety guardrails.
Connect DICOM viewer, AI inference pipelines, live WebSockets, and report generator UI.
Conduct penetration testing, HIPAA compliance audit verification, AI clinical output validation, and E2E QA.
Final multi-cloud production staging, database seeding, smoke testing, and cutover release.

tools_and_technologies.technology: Next.js / React, TypeScript, Cornerstone.js / OHIF Viewer Framework
tools_and_technologies.rationale: High-performance medical DICOM rendering and medical-grade UI responsiveness.

tools_and_technologies.technology: Python FastAPI, Celery, Redis, Orthanc DICOM Server
tools_and_technologies.rationale: Asynchronous API handling and seamless native integration with machine learning libraries.

tools_and_technologies.technology: PostgreSQL (pgvector), AWS S3 with KMS SSE Encryption
tools_and_technologies.rationale: HIPAA-compliant relational metadata storage alongside encrypted object storage for large DICOM datasets.

tools_and_technologies.technology: PyTorch (MedSAM / UNet), Gemini 1.5 Pro API, NeMo Guardrails
tools_and_technologies.rationale: Combines state-of-the-art vision models for segmentation with robust multimodal LLM diagnostic reasoning.

tools_and_technologies.technology: HL7 FHIR R4 API, DICOMweb (WADO-RS / QIDO-RS), WebSockets
tools_and_technologies.rationale: Ensures industry standard interoperability with hospital PACS and EHR platforms.

tools_and_technologies.technology: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, KMS) / GCP Multi-Cloud hybrid
tools_and_technologies.rationale: Delivers enterprise BAA compliance, high availability, and encrypted at-rest storage.

tools_and_technologies.technology: Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, HashiCorp Vault
tools_and_technologies.rationale: Enables automated infrastructure deployment and secret management under strict HIPAA requirements.
Provides full code auditability, issue tracking, and regulatory documentation management.

risk_analysis.risk: Resource Shortage in AI/ML & Medical Imaging domain
risk_analysis.reason: Building both custom 3D DICOM image segmentation and LLM clinical guardrails with only 1 dedicated AI engineer creates a single point of failure.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Utilize pre-trained medical vision models (e.g., MedSAM) and out-of-the-box LLM APIs rather than training segmentation networks from scratch.

risk_analysis.reason: Inadvertent exposure of Patient Health Information (PHI) via LLM prompt payloads or cloud storage misconfiguration.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Enforce strict local PHI anonymization/de-identification prior to external LLM calls and implement end-to-end KMS encryption.

risk_analysis.reason: Generative LLM summarizing patient histories could fabricate medical conditions or incorrect dosages.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Implement automated output validation guardrails, require human-in-the-loop radiologist approval, and display source citations.

risk_analysis.reason: Large volumetric CT/MRI DICOM series (hundreds of MBs) may cause browser lag or memory crashes.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Use progressive web streaming, WebAssembly (WASM) image decoding, and server-side frame extraction.

feasibility.key_verdict: The project is achievable within 75 days provided pre-trained vision models are leveraged and real-time co-presence features are deferred to post-MVP to offset the 1-employee resource gap.

ai_recommendation.primary_advice: Focus MVP scope strictly on core DICOM viewing, FHIR record summarization, and AI guardrails. Offload model training by adopting open-source medical models (MedSAM) to maintain schedule with 7 staff members.
actionable_steps: Step 1: Onboard 1 contractor or reallocate 1 backend engineer with AI pipeline experience to support the ML workload.
Step 2: Utilize open-source OHIF Viewer framework instead of building a DICOM canvas renderer from scratch.
Step 3: Implement strict automated de-identification proxy before sending text notes to the LLM API.

fef6ba04-be65-4d52-9fde-3cd89420b495.name: SwiftPay Global Micro-Merchant POS
fef6ba04-be65-4d52-9fde-3cd89420b495.description: Omnichannel payment gateway and real-time ledger engine for small retail merchants with instant settlement, QR code checkouts, and fraud anomaly detection.
fef6ba04-be65-4d52-9fde-3cd89420b495.requirements:
1. Multi-currency transaction processing with Stripe & Adyen payment gateway fallbacks
2. Merchant mobile-first PWA dashboard with real-time sales telemetry and settlement tracking
3. PCI-DSS compliant tokenization vault and AES-256 data encryption
4. Fraud detection rule engine and transaction velocity anomaly scoring
5. Automated daily PDF reconciliation statements and tax ledger exports
6. High-availability Redis caching layer for sub-50ms checkout authorization

summary.what_it_is: An omnichannel, high-performance payment gateway and real-time ledger platform designed for micro-merchants, enabling instant settlements, dynamic QR code checkouts, and real-time fraud detection.
summary.problem_solved: Eliminates high transaction processing fees, slow payout settlements, expensive point-of-sale hardware reliance, and fraud risks faced by small retail merchants.
summary.what_needs_to_be_built: A mobile-first PWA merchant dashboard, a PCI-DSS tokenization vault with multi-gateway routing (Stripe/Adyen), a sub-50ms Redis caching layer, an ML-driven velocity anomaly detection engine, and automated PDF reconciliation services.

must_have.name: Multi-Currency Gateway Routing & Fallbacks
must_have.description: Dynamic payment routing across Stripe and Adyen based on currency, availability, and transaction fees.
must_have.rationale: Ensures uninterrupted checkout capability and optimal processing costs across international currencies.

must_have.name: Mobile-First PWA Merchant Dashboard & QR Checkout
must_have.description: Progressive Web App featuring instantaneous dynamic QR code generation, real-time sales telemetry, and transaction tracking.
must_have.rationale: Provides retail merchants with a seamless POS terminal directly on low-cost mobile hardware without app store installation.

must_have.name: PCI-DSS Vault & AES-256 Tokenization Engine
must_have.description: Compliant tokenization store utilizing AES-256 encryption for cardholder data isolation and secure transmission.
must_have.rationale: Mandatory regulatory requirement for handling sensitive payment data safely.

must_have.name: Sub-50ms Redis Authorization Layer
must_have.description: High-availability memory store for session state, rate limiting, and instant merchant authorization responses.
must_have.rationale: Guarantees rapid checkout experience required at physical retail checkouts.

must_have.name: Fraud Detection & Velocity Anomaly Engine
must_have.description: Rule-based and machine learning anomaly engine monitoring transaction frequency, amount outliers, and geographic risk score.
must_have.rationale: Prevents chargeback losses and protects micro-merchants from automated card-testing fraud.

optional.name: Automated PDF Reconciliation & Tax Exports
optional.description: Scheduled daily PDF statement creation and downloadable tax ledger formats (CSV/XLSX/PDF).
optional.rationale: Reduces accounting effort for merchants, but non-critical for basic payment processing.

optional.name: Offline Transaction Staging
optional.description: Local caching of offline checkout requests that sync once internet connectivity resumes.
optional.rationale: Improves reliability in low-connectivity retail areas, but increases synchronization risk.

must_need_requirements.rationale: Ensures secure micro-service communications and prevents unauthorized payment operations.
Guarantees zero ledger discrepancies while supporting sub-50ms operational read times.
Enables real-time push updates to PWA dashboard and fast integration with third-party payment rails.
Identifies suspicious rapid-fire transaction patterns and fraudulent card testing in real-time.

items: Go / FastHttp or Node.js Async Microservices
must_need_requirements.rationale: Handles high throughput low-latency requests while offloading heavy PDF rendering asynchronously.

items: Web OTP API & QR Code Generator
must_need_requirements.rationale: Provides rapid touch-friendly UI response times across diverse mobile devices.
Provides PCI-compliant secure key storage, fast edge-based caching, and predictable deployment pipeline.

roles.rationale: Responsible for payment integrations, PCI compliance tokenization, gateway failovers, and ledger architecture.
Builds mobile-first responsive merchant interfaces, dynamic QR engine, and real-time sales telemetry dashboard.
Configures PCI-compliant cloud infrastructure, Redis cluster caching, network security, and CI/CD pipelines.
Develops transaction velocity anomaly detection models and risk scoring API.
Ensures payment edge cases, failovers, load testing, and security compliance are thoroughly tested.

employee_analysis.analysis_summary: The project requires at least 6 specialized engineers to comfortably build a secure, PCI-compliant payment platform with ML fraud scoring in 45 days. The current team of 4 will experience bandwidth bottlenecks across Security, DevOps, and QA.

phases.description: System architecture, tokenization vault specification, database schema creation, and PCI compliance scope definition.
Implement Stripe and Adyen payment rails with dynamic fallback logic and secure AES-256 vaulting.
Deploy Redis cluster for sub-50ms authorizations and construct double-entry ledger database operations.
Train velocity scoring models and integrate fraud rule evaluation into checkout authorization flow.
Build responsive PWA merchant dashboard, WebSocket telemetry UI, dynamic QR generator, and statement exporter.
Integrate frontend PWA with backend APIs, perform load tests to verify sub-50ms SLA, and simulate gateway outages.
Penetration testing, tokenization validation, infrastructure provisioning, and final production rollout.

tools_and_technologies.rationale: Delivers native-like mobile offline support, fast rendering, and instant responsiveness on low-end smartphones.
High-concurrency microservice handling for ultra-fast payment processing and clean ML integration.
Provides ACID transactions for double-entry financial accounting along with sub-50ms caching.
Fast CPU inference under 5ms for transaction velocity and anomaly scoring.
Ensures standard client-server communication and immediate telemetry pushes to POS terminals.

tools_and_technologies.technology: AWS ECS Fargate, Cloudflare API Shield, AWS KMS
tools_and_technologies.rationale: Secures cardholder environment according to PCI-DSS standards while maintaining serverless scalability.
Automates immutable infrastructure provisioning and real-time APM monitoring.
Maintains strict branch access controls, automated security scanning, and code review flows.

risk_analysis.reason: Building a custom PCI-DSS tokenization vault requires extensive security reviews, key management, and auditing.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Use a pre-certified tokenization service (e.g., Very Good Security / TokenEx) or store payment method tokens strictly downstream using Stripe/Adyen Vaults.

risk_analysis.reason: 4 available engineers must split work across full-stack PWA, payment vaulting, ML fraud models, and Redis caching within 45 days.
risk_analysis.mitigation: De-prioritize PDF reconciliation and tax ledger generation to Phase 2; focus team strictly on checkout core.

risk_analysis.risk: Sub-50ms SLA Breach during Gateway Fallbacks
risk_analysis.reason: Outbound HTTP calls to external payment processors (Stripe/Adyen) usually take 200ms-800ms.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Clarify sub-50ms SLA applies to local system tokenization and caching authorization check, offloading gateway submission asynchronously where permissible.

feasibility.key_verdict: The project is technically feasible within 45 days only if scope is trimmed (offloading tokenization vault management to third-party tools and moving PDF tax exports to post-launch) or by adding 2 engineers.

ai_recommendation.primary_advice: Leverage third-party PCI tokenization wrappers (e.g. VGS or gateway native vaults) to avoid spending 30% of engineering bandwidth on compliance, allowing the 4-person team to hit the 45-day deadline.
actionable_steps: Use Stripe Elements / Adyen Web SDK directly for tokenization to keep server completely out of PCI-DSS scope.
Convert automated PDF statement generator into an asynchronous nightly worker rather than real-time synchronous blocking.
Outsource ML fraud detection to rule-based velocity filters initially, deploying the trained ML model in v1.1.

1eae31db-d983-42d7-8e16-95a53ee97611.name: SmartFleet Autonomous Logistics IoT Hub
1eae31db-d983-42d7-8e16-95a53ee97611.description: Real-time cold-chain freight tracking telemetry hub supporting 50,000+ IoT GPS/temperature sensors with predictive maintenance alerts and dynamic route optimization.
1eae31db-d983-42d7-8e16-95a53ee97611.requirements:
1. High-throughput MQTT and WebSocket telemetry ingestion pipeline (10,000 msgs/sec)
2. Live interactive geospatial map with real-time vehicle clustering and route playback
3. Sensor temperature breach alerting and automated driver dispatch SMS webhooks
4. Predictive maintenance machine learning model for refrigeration unit failures
5. Dynamic route re-routing algorithm based on traffic, weather, and battery metrics
6. Enterprise customer multi-tenant portal with custom webhook triggers and SLA reports
7. Kubernetes auto-scaling cluster with TimescaleDB time-series persistence

summary.what_it_is: A real-time cold-chain freight tracking telemetry hub designed to ingest data from 50,000+ IoT sensors, providing live monitoring, breach alerts, and predictive fleet management.
summary.problem_solved: Eliminates high cargo spoilage rates, compliance non-conformity in cold-chain logistics, delayed breach response times, and unoptimized transit routes.
summary.what_needs_to_be_built: High-throughput MQTT/WebSocket ingestion pipeline, TimescaleDB time-series storage, Mapbox geospatial frontend, alerting & webhook engine, predictive maintenance ML service, dynamic route optimizer, and auto-scaling EKS infrastructure.

must_have.name: High-Throughput MQTT/WebSocket Pipeline
must_have.description: Ingestion backend capable of handling 10,000 msgs/sec telemetry data from 50,000+ GPS/temperature sensors.
must_have.rationale: Core backbone necessary for real-time tracking and monitoring.

must_have.name: Live Interactive Geospatial Map
must_have.description: Real-time vehicle clustering, route playback, and status indicators using Mapbox GL.
must_have.rationale: Essential operational UI for fleet dispatchers and operators.

must_have.name: Temperature Breach Alerting & Driver Dispatch SMS
must_have.description: Automated threshold monitoring triggering instant SMS/webhook notifications via Twilio.
must_have.rationale: Critical business metric to prevent cold-chain cargo destruction.

must_have.name: TimescaleDB Time-Series Data Layer & K8s Scaling
must_have.description: Auto-partitioned time-series persistence on PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB hosted on Kubernetes.
must_have.rationale: Required to sustainably store millions of daily sensor metrics.

optional.name: Predictive Maintenance ML Model
optional.description: Machine learning model identifying refrigeration unit failure patterns prior to total breakdown.
optional.rationale: High value add, but secondary to core telemetry ingestion MVP.

optional.name: Dynamic Route Re-Routing Algorithm
optional.description: Algorithmic path recalculation incorporating traffic, weather, and battery metrics.
optional.rationale: Optimizes fuel and efficiency, but non-essential for initial MVP launch.

optional.name: Multi-Tenant Enterprise SLA Reports
optional.description: Custom reporting engine and configurable webhook triggers for external enterprise customers.
optional.rationale: Required for multi-client SaaS monetisation, but can be phased after core telemetry works.

must_need_requirements.rationale: Ensures isolated tenant data access and secure administrative actions.
TimescaleDB handles high-volume time-series write workloads, while Redis buffers live WebSocket state.
Essential for sensor ingestion, instant web dashboard streaming, and external alerting.
Powers refrigeration unit failure prediction based on historical degradation trends.
Go provides low-latency ingestion at 10,000 msgs/sec; Python manages ML and business logic.
Delivers smooth 60fps geospatial rendering and responsive monitoring dashboards.
Guarantees automated dynamic scaling under peak sensor load and high system visibility.

roles.rationale: Required to build interactive geospatial mapping, route playback, and complex UI components.
Needed for 10k msg/sec ingestion pipeline, websocket streams, and multi-tenant logic.
Responsible for training and deploying the predictive maintenance ML model.
Required to design intuition-driven live dispatch interfaces and tenant dashboards.
Essential to configure auto-scaling Kubernetes cluster, TimescaleDB deployment, and MQTT brokers.
Needed to conduct high-load telemetry testing and end-to-end integration testing.

employee_analysis.analysis_summary: Critical headcount shortage. Completing a 10,000 msg/sec ingestion pipeline with Kubernetes, ML models, and interactive mapping with only 2 developers in 20 days is impossible without severe scope reduction.

phases.description: Architect DB schema, deploy core EKS cluster, EMQX MQTT broker, and TimescaleDB.
Build high-throughput Go MQTT subscriber engine and Redis pub/sub streaming.
Develop Next.js mapping dashboard with vehicle clustering and route playback.
Implement temperature breach detector, Twilio SMS webhooks, and tenant notification portal.
Train predictive maintenance model and construct basic route re-routing algorithm.
Connect frontend, backend ML, alerts, and conduct load stress testing up to 10k msgs/sec.
Final sanity checks, domain setup, and live system deployment to Kubernetes cluster.

tools_and_technologies.rationale: Fast client rendering and robust web map performance for live vehicle clustering.
Go offers maximum performance for 10k msgs/sec MQTT ingestion; FastAPI handles ML/REST endpoints.
TimescaleDB manages continuous time-series writes; Redis powers live WebSocket publishing.
Efficient tabbed sensor data learning for predictive hardware failure identification.

tools_and_technologies.technology: EMQX MQTT, WebSockets, REST, Twilio Webhooks
tools_and_technologies.rationale: Standard high-performance telemetry ingestion and instant client alerting protocol stack.
Auto-scaling infrastructure capable of handling bursts in IoT data volume.
Automated deployment pipelines paired with real-time cluster telemetry monitoring.
Standard branch governance, automated PR checks, and codebase collaboration.

risk_analysis.reason: Only 2 engineers available to build complex distributed K8s, ML, and real-time mapping systems.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Immediately freeze optional ML and dynamic routing scope; focus purely on MQTT ingestion MVP.

risk_analysis.reason: 10,000 msgs/sec can cause DB write latency spikes or memory exhaustion if unbuffered.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Utilize Go-based MQTT consumers with Redis buffering prior to batched TimescaleDB inserts.

risk_analysis.reason: 20 days is insufficient for full enterprise-ready multi-tenant dynamic routing features.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Utilize managed cloud infrastructure (AWS Managed Grafana/Timescale Cloud) and pre-built Mapbox templates.

feasibility.key_verdict: Building an auto-scaling IoT hub with 10k msgs/sec ingestion, predictive ML, dynamic routing, and multi-tenancy with 2 engineers in 20 days is technically infeasible without dropping major features.

ai_recommendation.primary_advice: Descope the project to an 'IoT Telemetry MVP' focusing solely on core ingestion, TimescaleDB storage, live mapping, and simple SMS alerts. Defer ML models and dynamic routing to Phase 2.
actionable_steps: Step 1: Descope Predictive Maintenance ML, Dynamic Route Re-routing, and Multi-tenant SLA custom reports.
Step 2: Assign Engineer 1 exclusively to Backend/DevOps (EKS, EMQX, Go ingestion, TimescaleDB).
Step 3: Assign Engineer 2 exclusively to Frontend/APIs (Next.js, Mapbox, WebSockets, Twilio webhooks).
Step 4: Use managed Cloud services (AWS MSK / Managed TimescaleDB) to avoid manual K8s DB maintenance overhead.

optional_features_to_drop: Enterprise customer multi-tenant portal with custom SLA reports
